question: Average function is listed in the drop-down menu of which of the following tools?
solution:
The correct answer is **Auto Sum function**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Average function** is listed in the drop-down menu of the **Auto Sum function** tool.
 
• The Auto Sum function provides quick access to common functions such as Sum, Average, Count, Max, and Mi
